g.title: Sheet.1144
g.desc: When an edge port receives a BPDU, it acts as a normal STP po...
g.text: When an edge port receives a BPDU, it acts as a normal STP port. It goes through the STA steps and chooses a role depending on the BID, the root path cost, and the port ID of the remote switch.
